risks: No Snowflake experience shown on the CV (c3).
Only one AI use is quantified, so AI evidence is moderate (c4).
Four spelling and grammar slips in a CV for a senior role (c6, c7).
Several bullets describe duties with no result (c8) and some phrasing reads as stock AI wording (c5).
actions: Fix the two spelling errors and two grammar errors before applying (c6, c7).
Add a result to the duty bullets, or cut them (c8).
Add Snowflake or similar warehouse experience if true, for example via the Power BI reporting (c3).
Quantify the fraud-alert and Copilot outcomes (c4).
